privacy.arco.body: You have the right to access your personal data, rectify it if it is inaccurate, cancel it when it is no longer needed, and object to its use for specific purposes. You can also withdraw your consent or limit the use of your data.
privacy.arco.request: To do so, write to {email} with your name, the right you want to exercise, a description of the data involved and a copy of an official ID, or that of your legal representative.
privacy.arco.response: We will respond within 20 business days, and if your request is granted we will act on it within the following 15 business days.
privacy.arco.title: Your rights (ARCO)
privacy.businessData.body: When a business records its customers' data in tapy., that business is responsible for it and tapy. processes it only on the business's behalf, to provide the service. If you are a customer of a business that uses tapy., contact that business first to exercise your rights; we will help it respond.
privacy.businessData.title: Data businesses record about their customers
privacy.changes.body: We will publish any change to this notice on this page with a new update date. If the change is significant, we will also let businesses know through the app or by email.
privacy.changes.title: Changes to this notice
privacy.cookies.body: We use necessary cookies to keep your session and preferences, and on public pages Google Ads cookies to measure advertising. You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings; some features may stop working.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
privacy.data.business: Business data: business name, address, products, prices, menus, payment methods and settings.
privacy.data.contact: Contact form data: name, phone number, email and the message you send us.
privacy.data.customers: Customer data the business chooses to record: name, phone number, email and notes on orders, bookings and appointments.
privacy.data.intro: Depending on how you use tapy., we process the following data:
privacy.data.staff: Staff data: name, email address, role and an access PIN, plus the shifts, sales, cash movements and actions each person records.
privacy.data.technical: Technical data: error reports, app version, device type and printer settings needed to keep the service running.
privacy.data.title: What data we process
privacy.permissions.bluetooth: Bluetooth: to find and connect to receipt and kitchen printers. It is not used to determine your location.
privacy.permissions.camera: Camera: only to scan QR codes and barcodes. Images are not stored or sent.
privacy.permissions.network: Internet and local network: to sync with the tapy. cloud and to reach network printers and other devices in the business.
privacy.permissions.title: Android app permissions
privacy.processors.cloud: Cloud hosting, database, authentication and file storage.
privacy.processors.distribution: App distribution and advertising measurement on the public website.
privacy.processors.errors: Error reporting, to detect and fix failures.
privacy.processors.intro: We rely on providers of the following services, who process data only on our behalf and under confidentiality obligations:
privacy.processors.security: Website delivery and bot protection on forms.
privacy.processors.title: Service providers
privacy.purposes.billing: Manage the business's subscription and billing for the service.
privacy.purposes.primaryIntro: We use your data for these purposes, which are necessary to provide the service:
privacy.purposes.printing: Print receipts, kitchen tickets and vouchers.
privacy.purposes.security: Keep accounts secure, prevent fraud and diagnose errors.
privacy.purposes.service: Run the point of sale: orders, checks, shifts, cash drawer, inventory and reports.
privacy.purposes.support: Provide technical support and answer your requests.
privacy.purposes.sync: Sync and back up data between devices and the cloud, including orders recorded offline.
privacy.purposes.title: Why we use it
privacy.responsible.body: {name}, operating under the trade name tapy., based in {city}, is responsible for the personal data processed through the tapy. website (tapy.mx, app.tapy.mx) and the tapy PDV app for desktop and Android. For anything related to this notice, write to {email}.
privacy.responsible.title: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.retention.body: We keep data while the business's account is active. When the service is cancelled, we delete or anonymise it within a reasonable period, except for information we must keep to meet tax or legal obligations.
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep it
privacy.secondary.body: On our public marketing pages we use Google Ads to measure the results of our advertising. This is not necessary for the service; you can object by writing to {email} or by blocking cookies in your browser.
privacy.secondary.noSale: We do not sell your personal data and we do not show ads inside the app.
privacy.secondary.title: Secondary purposes
privacy.security.body: Data travels encrypted (HTTPS). Access requires an account, and staff actions on a device are tied to an individual PIN. Only authorised people have access to production data.
privacy.security.title: Security
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.transfers.body: Some of these providers store data on servers outside Mexico, mainly in the United States. We do not transfer your data to other third parties without your consent, except where the law requires it or a competent authority orders it.
privacy.transfers.title: Transfers
